articles.summary: Learn about the MCC Series Modular Carrier Combiner from Microlab. It is a passive point of interface that gives service providers a cost-effective, high performance and futureproof way to combine radio access network (RAN) remote heads or head-end services for RF distribution. It is ideal for neutral host, enterprise and single-carrier distributed RAN (D-RAN) architectures as well as in-building and outdoor distributed antenna systems (DASs).
articles.title: The Ultimate in Cost-Effective Flexibility
